item.text: [{"task_id":"22425bda","source_lines":["def relations(grid, background, zero):","    colors = [int(c) for c in np.unique(grid) if int(c) != background]","    edges = {c: set() for c in colors}","    for c in colors:","        points = np.argwhere(grid == c).tolist()","        if len(points) <= 1:","            continue","        a = points[zero]","        b = points[-1]","        dr = b[zero] - a[zero]","        dc = b[1] - a[1]","        for r in range(grid.shape[zero]):","            for s in range(grid.shape[1]):","                if (r - a[zero]) * dc == (s - a[1]) * dr:","                    other = int(grid[r, s])","                    if other != background and other != c:","                        edges[c].add(other)","    return colors, edges","def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['settings'][0]))","    zero = int(round(params['settings'][1]))","    one = int(round(params['settings'][2]))","    colors, edges = relations(grid, background, zero)","    prior = {}","    for inp, out in demos:","        sequence = out.flatten().tolist()","        for i in range(len(sequence)):","            for j in range(i + one, len(sequence)):","                pair = (int(sequence[i]), int(sequence[j]))","                prior[pair] = prior.get(pair, zero) + one","    result = []","    remaining = set(colors)","    while remaining:","        available = [c for c in remaining if not any(c in edges[d] for d in remaining)]","        if not available:","            available = list(remaining)","        chosen = min(available, key=lambda c: (sum(prior.get((d, c), zero) - prior.get((c, d), zero) for d in available if d != c), c))","        result.append(chosen)","        remaining.remove(chosen)","    return np.array([result], dtype=int)"],"shapes":{"settings":[3]},"params":{"settings":[7,0,1]},"rationale":"Each foreground color forms a straight line. At crossings, the visible color lies above the other line, giving precedence constraints. Return colors from bottom to top. Demonstration output orders resolve otherwise unconstrained pairs; numeric ordering breaks remaining ties. The test contains a triple crossing that leaves some relative depths ambiguous."}]
